raw: I stepped in dog droppings on the sidewalk, and there was this brown smear across my shoe. Just looking at it made me feel sick, but the smell was worse. It followed me onto the bus—that’s the part I really remember. You leave the mess behind on the pavement, but you haven’t actually left it behind because it’s on your shoe. I kept noticing that smell and thinking about what I’d stepped in. Ugh.
